evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%.
